**Quaternion-Octonion SU (3) Flavor Symmetry**

*Pushpa(1), P. S. Bisht (1,2), Tianjun Li (2) and O. P. S. Negi (1)*

12 pp, 3 sections.

**Abstract.** Starting with the quaternionic formulation of isospin SU (2) group, we have derived the relations for diﬀerent components of isospin with quark sta tes. Extending this formalism to the case of SU (3) group we have considered the theory of octonion variables. A ccordingly, the octonion splitting of SU (3) group have been reconsidered and various commutation relat ions for SU (3) group and its shift operators are also derived and veriﬁed fo r diﬀerent iso-spin multiplets i.e. I, U and V - spins.

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 5 Commutation relations for Octonion Valued Sh; 6 Discussion and Conclusion
